title: Tracefab textile certification standards reference
disclaimer: This catalogue identifies standards and evidence fields only. A catalogue entry is not proof that an organization, product or material is certified.

standards.name: Global Organic Textile Standard
standards.claimCaveat: Certification status and scope must be checked against the certificate and issuing body; the catalogue does not validate either.

standards.name: OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100
standards.claimCaveat: The product class and certificate scope must be retained with the evidence; a STANDARD 100 entry is not a safety or certification conclusion by Tracefab.

standards.name: Global Recycled Standard
standards.claimCaveat: Recycled content, scope and chain-of-custody claims require the applicable certificate and transaction evidence.

standards.name: Recycled Claim Standard
standards.claimCaveat: The catalogue records the declared standard only; it does not establish recycled content or certification validity.

standards.name: Organic Content Standard
standards.claimCaveat: Organic content and chain-of-custody claims require independent evidence; a declared OCS record remains unverified.

standards.name: Environmental management systems
standards.claimCaveat: ISO does not certify organizations itself; the certificate and accredited certification body remain the evidence source.

standards.name: Quality management systems
standards.claimCaveat: ISO does not certify organizations itself; the certificate and accredited certification body remain the evidence source.
